page: p. 50 (leaf n69), Table of Seven Graffiti of Philae, row A; facsimile p. 33 (leaf n52)
site: Philae, Temple of Isis, First Pylon, north face of the east tower (cut from the roof of the court, about 2.5 m above it)
notes: Read from Griffith's type in the comparative table (row A, marked 'end'). p. 33 also prints Schaefer's hand-copy as a drawn facsimile, which Griffith calls faultless (p. 34 n. 1); his own copy in Pl. XVII has the mistake of y for se. The facsimile agrees with the type and shows the stone lines as tewisti : t / nye wide a / pote yeSo. Griffith: 'The obeisance made by Tanaye, the wize, on behalf of the envoy' (p. 34); 'The adoration made by (?) the wize of Tanaye the envoy' (p. 51); 'shortest, and does not name the deity'. The '?' on the e of tNye is Griffith's.
